name: App Icon: Duotone Slashed Koban Fortune
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Samurai + Money Fusion.
description: Solid pitch-black samurai silhouette slicing an oval Japanese gold/red Koban wealth coin in half, framed inside a flat bright red circular sun.
prompt: Masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector logo icon representing samurai wealth. Solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai warrior slicing a traditional oval Japanese Koban wealth coin in half with a katana blade. (Directly centered inside a single solid flat bright red circular sun disc:1.4). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only (#FF2035). Flat 2D graphic logo, razor-sharp clean geometric edges, no 3D shading, no gradients, no textures, no noise, no text, no watermark.
